Nina (AE): Quick check — MegaRetail procurement insists on buying via Azure Marketplace and they require those charges to count against the Dedicated commit we quoted. Is that allowed?
Carlos (Deals): Marketplace channels are separate by default. We can consider an offset but it's a Deal Desk exception + accounting confirmation.
Priya (Finance): We need invoice-level detail and an SKU mapping to match marketplace lines to our internal ratecard. Also need GL treatment for credit memos.
Nina (AE): Customer can share last month9s Marketplace invoice. Uploading to the ticket now.
OpsBot: Created SD-5033 and attached invoice link (assigned to Carlos).
Logan (PSC): Technical: Azure marketplace SKUs often include partner markup and different unit names. I'll create a SKU mapping template: marketplace_sku, internal_sku, unit_type, token_equiv. ETA EOD.
Kira (Legal): Legal will require an addendum: marketplace purchases eligible for offset subject to SKU mapping, reconciliation, and audit rights. Also flag tax/reseller language.
Carlos (Deals): Plan: 1) get invoice sample, 2) PSC SKU map, 3) Deal Desk review, 4) Finance approves GL flow, 5) legal addendum signed.
Priya (Finance): Draft reconciliation flow: customer uploads invoice detail monthly -> SalesOps matches SKUs -> Finance issues credit memo up to committed balance -> disputes resolved within 30 days.
Nina (AE): Uploaded invoice to SD-5033.
Logan (PSC): SKU template posted: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/sd-5033-sku-map.csv
Carlos (Deals): Submitting Deal Desk package now. Will update thread when approved.
Priya (Finance): If approved, accounting wants one month of reconciled runs before finalizing GL treatment.
Carlos (Deals): Deal Desk response: provisional approval pending invoice/SKU verification and signed addendum. Logged in SD-5033.
Nina (AE): Thanks — will push procurement to sign addendum once we have it.
Kira (Legal): Will draft addendum; estimated 2 business days to finalize.
Carlos (Deals): TL;DR: One-off allowed with controls; recommend templating if this repeats.
